purpose: Define the derived source-specific reading queue required to turn domain field slots into exact claim, endpoint, population, uncertainty and transfer-boundary Source Cards.

scope.selectionRule: Derive one task for every sourceCardId attached to every field row in the domain Source Card field-extraction register.
currentLimitations: This queue derives source-specific reading tasks; it does not contain completed source-specific extractions.
A queued task is not evidence that the cited source supports the domain endpoint.
No queued row may be promoted into calibrated modeling until exact claim, endpoint, population, uncertainty and transfer-boundary fields are filled from the source.
The queue covers current priority domains only; C2 long-tail domains still need future inclusion.

queueDefaults.minimumExtractionQuestion: For this domain-source pair, what exact claim, endpoint, population, uncertainty and transfer boundary can this source support without overclaiming?

remainingWork: Generate source-specific Source Card rows for each derived task.
Fill exact claim use, endpoint definition, population/sample, effect/mechanism signal, uncertainty/bias and transfer boundary.
Only after field completion, decide whether a domain-source pair is eligible for qualitative support, model variable transfer, downgrade or rejection.

nonClaims: This queue does not validate that any source supports any domain claim.
This queue does not complete source-specific reading.
This queue does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, intervention ranking or individual death-date output.
This queue does not complete C2 long-tail domain coverage.
